# gyro_storage_key (Resource)

An S3 access key. The secret is only returned at creation (kept in state, sensitive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_storage_key" "ci" {
  service_id = 456
  label      = "ci-uploader"
}

output "s3_secret" {
  value     = gyro_storage_key.ci.secret_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String)
- `service_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive)
